A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SHARP research work. Their complete main texts, appendices A–E, equations, tables, and figures are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original SHARP benchmark results in Section 4 and Table 1, with additional runtime measurements, ablations, and motion-range analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results and supplementary empirical analyses, including comparisons with baselines and controlled ablations.

M1.justification: Equation 3.11 changes the stated depth-scale regularizer from E[|S(p)|] to E[|S(p)−1|], penalizing deviation from unit scaling instead of zero. This is a limited correction to the documented training objective; the PDFs do not establish an implementation change or retraining. The architecture and inference procedure remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic and real-image training sources and evaluate on Middlebury, Booster, ScanNet++, WildRGBD, Tanks and Temples, and ETH3D. Unsplash examples, privileged-depth evaluations, and extended-motion scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparators remain Flash3D, TMPI, LVSM, SVC, ViewCrafter, and Gen3C, with unchanged membership in corresponding main and supplementary comparisons. Flash3D retraining comparisons and the TMPI depth-backbone adaptation already appear in v1. Updated citations do not introduce new baselines.

E3.justification: Section D.5 and Table 14 revise the reported Gaussian configurations from 2×196×196, 2×392×392, and 2×784×784 to 2×192×192, 2×384×384, and 2×768×768. These are corrected ablation settings, consistent with the full-model dimensions already stated in Section 3.1. No rerun is established; other evaluation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The same loss, Gram-matrix, depth-adjustment, fine-tuning, backbone, and Gaussian-count ablations remain, alongside unchanged metric-sensitivity, motion-range, and failure-case analyses. Table 14 corrects configuration labels but adds no analysis, result measurements, or qualitative evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions report means over test samples and the same standard-deviation shading and single-sample-bin convention in Figure 7. No repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Reported performance scores, runtimes, rankings, plotted results, and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains SHARP's ScanNet++ DISTS of 0.071 and LPIPS of 0.154. Table 14 changes configuration labels, not its metric entries.

T1.justification: Equation 3.11 revises the mathematical definition of the scale penalty, moving its minimum from S=0 to S=1. This changes the formula's meaning. Other equation edits concern punctuation or set notation, and no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and scope: fast monocular Gaussian reconstruction, metric scale, photorealistic nearby views, and zero-shot generalization. The claimed 25–34% LPIPS and 21–43% DISTS reductions and synthesis-speed advantage are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same explanations of depth ambiguity, loss effects, and fine-tuning, as well as the nearby-view applicability boundary and diffusion-model tradeoffs. The macro-photo, night-scene, and reflection failures and their attributed causes remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The corrected Gaussian-grid dimensions in Section D.5 and Table 14 make the documented ablation configurations consistent with Section 3.1, improving reproducibility information. Optimizer settings, loss weights, hardware, training schedules, data descriptions, and code-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain the same after matching titles across updated references. Changes correct author names and bibliographic metadata or replace preprint details with publication details, including LRM, MoGe, and ViewCrafter; they do not expand related-work coverage.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized grammar, terminology, notation, and bibliography edits. It corrects 'encoder' to 'decoder' in Section 3.2 and the Flash3D retraining reference from Table 1 to Table 4 in Section D.2. Section organization and the overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The activation-function table in Appendix A.1 is reformatted with horizontal rules, and Table 2 simplifies metric-arrow headers. Minor caption edits and page reflow also occur. The figures, qualitative image panels, and overall table organization are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves technical consistency: Equation 3.11 now favors the identity multiplicative depth adjustment, and Table 14's Gaussian dimensions agree with Section 3.1. The corrected table cross-reference and editorial cleanup also aid reading. These are useful, limited repairs; the empirical evidence and central claims remain unchanged.
